Plastics Evaluation at a Glance

Material system

Resin; virgin, recycled, blended, filled or reinforced where relevant

TiO₂ introduction route

Direct powder, compound or masterbatch

Processing

Conversion process, process window and finished specimen

Optical

Whiteness, opacity and surface condition in the finished system

Dispersion & defects

FPV, film test, gels, black specks, holes and other line defects

Exposure

Indoor, outdoor, warm, wet or chemical conditions; stated test methods

Grades to Review

Eight candidate Grades across chloride and sulfate routes
